```go
package godump

import (
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"reflect"
	"sort"
	"strconv"
	"strings"
)

const defaultMaxDepth = 64

// Printer renders Go values as indented, human-readable text.
type Printer struct {
	// MaxDepth limits recursion depth. Zero means defaultMaxDepth. Negative
	// means unlimited.
	MaxDepth int

	out     strings.Builder
	depth   int
	visited map[visit]bool
}

type visit struct {
	ptr uintptr
	typ reflect.Type
}

// Sdump returns the pretty-printed representation of the supplied values.
func Sdump(values ...any) string {
	p := &Printer{}
	return p.Sdump(values...)
}

// Dump pretty-prints the supplied values to standard output.
func Dump(values ...any) {
	fmt.Print(Sdump(values...))
}

func (p *Printer) Sdump(values ...any) string {
	p.out.Reset()
	p.visited = make(map[visit]bool)
	for i, v := range values {
		if i > 0 {
			p.out.WriteString("\n")
		}
		p.depth = 0
		p.print(reflect.ValueOf(v))
	}
	return p.out.String()
}
```

```go
func (p *Printer) enter(v reflect.Value) bool {
	// returns true if already on the path (cycle)
	if p.visited == nil {
		p.visited = make(map[visit]bool)
	}
	key := visit{v.Pointer(), v.Type()}
	if p.visited[key] {
		return true
	}
	p.visited[key] = true
	return false
}
func (p *Printer) exit(v reflect.Value) {
	delete(p.visited, visit{v.Pointer(), v.Type()})
}
```

```go
// human-readable text suitable for debugging.

	// MaxDepth caps recursion into nested values. Zero selects
	// defaultMaxDepth; a negative value disables the limit.
	MaxDepth int

	// Output is the destination used by Dump. It defaults to os.Stdout.
	Output *os.File

	out     strings.Builder
	depth   int
	visited map[visit]bool
}

	ptr uintptr
	typ reflect.Type
}

// Sdump returns the pretty-printed form of values.
func Sdump(values ...any) string {
	return (&Printer{}).Sdump(values...)
}

// Dump writes the pretty-printed form of values to os.Stdout.
func Dump(values ...any) {
	fmt.Print(Sdump(values...))
}
```

```go
func (p *Printer) Sdump(values ...any) string {
	p.out.Reset()
	p.visited = make(map[visit]bool)
	for i, v := range values {
		if i > 0 {
			p.out.WriteByte('\n')
		}
		p.depth = 0
		p.print(reflect.ValueOf(v))
	}
	return p.out.String()
}

func (p *Printer) depthLimit() int {
	if p.MaxDepth == 0 {
		return defaultMaxDepth
	}
	return p.MaxDepth
}

func (p *Printer) print(v reflect.Value) {
	if !v.IsValid() {
		p.out.WriteString("<invalid>")
		return
	}
	if max := p.depthLimit(); max > 0 && p.depth > max {
		p.out.WriteString("...")
		return
	}

	switch v.Kind() {
	case reflect.Bool:
		p.out.WriteString(strconv.FormatBool(v.Bool()))
	case reflect.Int, reflect.Int8, reflect.Int16, reflect.Int32, reflect.Int64:
		p.out.WriteString(strconv.FormatInt(v.Int(), 10))
	case reflect.Uint, reflect.Uint8, reflect.Uint16, reflect.Uint32, reflect.Uint64:
		p.out.WriteString(strconv.FormatUint(v.Uint(), 10))
	case reflect.Uintptr:
		p.out.WriteString("0x" + strconv.FormatUint(v.Uint(), 16))
	case reflect.Float32, reflect.Float64:
		p.out.WriteString(strconv.FormatFloat(v.Float(), 'g', -1, v.Type().Bits()))
	case reflect.Complex64, reflect.Complex128:
		p.out.WriteString(strconv.FormatComplex(v.Complex(), 'g', -1, v.Type().Bits()))
	case reflect.String:
		p.out.WriteString(strconv.Quote(v.String()))
	case reflect.Interface:
		p.printInterface(v)
	case reflect.Pointer:
		p.printPointer(v)
	case reflect.Struct:
		p.printStruct(v)
	case reflect.Array:
		p.printArray(v)
	case reflect.Slice:
		p.printSlice(v)
	case reflect.Map:
		p.printMap(v)
	case reflect.Chan:
		if v.IsNil() {
			p.writeNil(v)
			return
		}
		fmt.Fprintf(&p.out, "(%s)(0x%x)", v.Type(), v.Pointer())
	case reflect.Func:
		if v.IsNil() {
			p.writeNil(v)
			return
		}
		fmt.Fprintf(&p.out, "(%s)(0x%x)", v.Type(), v.Pointer())
	case reflect.UnsafePointer:
		if v.IsNil() {
			p.writeNil(v)
			return
		}
		fmt.Fprintf(&p.out, "unsafe.Pointer(0x%x)", v.Pointer())
	default:
		fmt.Fprintf(&p.out, "<%s>", v.Kind())
	}
}
```
